assessment_summary: Reviewed the guide (Manual Start via Docker Compose) and the installation summary, then inspected the resulting environment. Verified Docker Engine 29.7.2 / Compose v5.5.0 and the running compose project 'harbor-local'. Confirmed all nine expected services (portal, core, jobservice, registry, registryctl, trivy-adapter, exporter, postgresql, redis) are up and reported healthy via both docker ps and the harbor-local compose ps output. Queried Harbor's own API: /api/v2.0/ping returned Pong (200) and /api/v2.0/health returned 200 with every component healthy. Confirmed the web UI serves (HTTP 200, <title>Harbor</title>). Validated authentication and functional behavior described in the guide: authenticated API call with admin/Harbor12345 listed the 'library' project, docker login to localhost:80 succeeded, and a full push/pull cycle of a freshly tagged alpine image succeeded (push returned a registry digest, local image removed, pull re-downloaded it), demonstrating real OCI artifact storage and retrieval. Verified config artifacts match the guide: .env created from .env.example with IMAGE_REPO=8gears.container-registry.com/8gcr/, HARBOR_TAG=v2.15.0, TLS disabled via /dev/null; token_service_key.pem is a valid traditional RSA key with mode 644. Scanned core/jobservice/registry/portal logs for error/fatal/panic — none found. The guide's optional HTTPS/mkcert configuration was not applied but is explicitly optional and the TLS-disabled default is fully functional, so it does not indicate failure. The unauthenticated /v2/_catalog 401 is expected behavior. All decisive checks passed, so the installation is assessed as complete and operational.
